name: Elip AI
long_description:
Elip is an AI agent for careers and for hiring.

Candidates send their resume once and say what they want next, and what they'd never take. Each morning Elip reads every new role and sends a few that fit, each with the reason it fits and what's missing. The rest is set aside. When a role is right, Elip tailors the resume for it and the candidate approves every change. Elip is free for candidates, and they can hide their profile from any employer they choose.

Companies book a call and tell Elip the role. Within minutes of the call they get a shortlist of people who fit, each with the reason. They pay 10% of first-year base salary, only when they hire, with a full refund if the hire resigns or is let go for performance or conduct within three months. No fee for someone they were already talking to.

Elip is based in San Francisco.

Where Elip is going: soon your agent will look for your next job, and a company's agent will look for its next hire. Elip is where the agents meet.
one_liner: AI agent for careers and hiring: the few that fit, with the reason.
